summary: PayPay Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited second-quarter results for the period ended September 30, 2026, prepared under IFRS. Total revenue rose 28% year-on-year to ¥118.1 billion, with the Payment segment up 27% and Financial Services up 38%; profit for the period was ¥18.4 billion and the adjusted EBITDA margin reached 36%. Management raised full-year guidance for fiscal 2027 to revenue of ¥474–478 billion and adjusted EBITDA of ¥159–163 billion. No transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; this is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
